description: This file defines the PooledBufferStream class, which implements a stream backed by pooled buffers, providing efficient read/write operations and integration with object pools for recycling instances. It appears to be a core utility class used within the Orleans serialization buffers component.

classes.name: PooledBufferStream
classes.description: A Stream implementation that uses pooled buffers for efficient memory management, supporting read/write, seek, and sequence rental functionalities.

classes.name: BufferSegment
classes.description: A nested class representing a segment of buffer used within the ReadOnlySequence, with pooling capabilities for efficient reuse.

methods.name: PooledBufferStream
methods.description: Default constructor initializing with zero minimum allocation size.

methods.name: PooledBufferStream(int minAllocationSize)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a specified minimum allocation size.

methods.name: Rent
methods.description: Static method to rent an instance from the object pool.

methods.name: Return
methods.description: Static method to return an instance to the object pool.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Returns the written data as a byte array.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies content to a supplied buffer writer.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream, returning buffers to the pool and clearing internal states.

methods.name: RentReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Creates and rents a ReadOnlySequence<byte> representing the written data.

methods.name: ReturnReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a rented ReadOnlySequence<byte> to the pool.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Sets the stream's position based on offset and origin.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into a buffer.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the stream, truncating or expanding as needed.

methods.name: Grow
methods.description: Allocates a new buffer and adds it to the segment list.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer into the stream.
